dataset: BodyParts3D version 4.0, PART-OF Tree, polygon reduction rate = 99%
license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (official publisher license updated 2025-02-27)
attribution: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International
source_license_notice: OBJ comments contain the historical CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan attribution. Files were not edited; current official lic.html and latest README explicitly update database license to CC BY 4.0 in February 2025.
methodology: Anatomical reference atlas derived from the TARO 2-mm whole-body MRI male volunteer model, with manual anatomical refinement. This is not a subject-specific clinical vessel segmentation.
coordinate_policy: All OBJ vertices are in the shared original BodyParts3D whole-body coordinate system. Keep all pulmonary artery and vein coordinates together. Apply one global centering and isotropic scale only. Do not independently normalize individual parts.
transformations: Selected pulmonary arterial tree FMA45842 and four pulmonary vein roots FMA49911, FMA49913, FMA49914, FMA49916 from the official PART-OF compound-organ mapping.
Excluded FJ2041 and FJ2044 because they are spatially detached below the other pulmonary vasculature. Excluded meshes were not repositioned or replaced.
Concatenated original OBJ vertices and offset face indices; no vertex coordinates were changed. OBJ polygons, if any, were triangulated by a fan.
Assigned face labels from official anatomical grouping: 0 arteries, 1 veins.
